description: M7 parity I — old HIGH-vuln (age 70), identical financials. risk_class=3<4 no CONTRADICTION, SUITABLE. Paired with scenario 125.
client_narrative: Antonella Ricci is 70 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 55,000 euros (around 4,583 euros per month). They hold 200,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 40,000 euros with a 6-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has moderate investment experience, including equities, mutual funds, and standard bond instruments. Their investment approach is moderate — they rate their risk tolerance at 6 out of 10. They have confirmed they can afford to lose the entire 40,000 euros if the investment performs poorly. They have been assessed as financially vulnerable.
product_narrative: The product is a UCITS exchange-traded fund tracking the Bloomberg Euro Aggregate Corporate Index, holding EUR-denominated investment-grade bonds rated at minimum BBB-. The fund publishes a KID, trades on regulated exchanges, uses no leverage, and contains no embedded derivatives. It is classified NON-COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a). The recommended minimum holding period is three years.
